intended_object: An auxiliary index map. It sends a point (p, q) on the anti-diagonal of total degree j = i − 1 to the point (p, q + 1) on the anti-diagonal of degree i. That point is the source coordinate of the vertical-differential component in the explicit differential of the product total complex. This reading comes from the docstring and from how the definition is used in the same file.
explanation: This is bookkeeping for indices: a map between subtypes `Diag j → Diag i` that adds 1 to the second coordinate, with an `omega` proof that the result lies on the right anti-diagonal. It is used only to write out the components of the differential of the product total complex. A lemma in the file, `nextHorizontalIndex_diag`, relates it to the file's other index helpers. It is an implementation detail with no standalone counterpart in the mathematical literature.
